subject: general
question: A man travelled a distance of 44 km in 4 hours. He travelled partly on foot at the speed of 7 km/h and partly on bicycle at the speed of 15 km/h. The distance travelled on bicycle is:
solution:
Formula:

D = S × T, where

D = Distance

S = Speed

T = Time

Calculation:

Let the time for which man travel partly on bicycle be "t" hours.

⇒ Distance covered by the man on bicycle = 15 × t = 15t

Time for which man travels on foot = (4 - t) hours

Distance travelled on foot = (4 - t) × 7

According to the question,

⇒ (4 - t) × 7 + 15t = 44 km

⇒ 28 - 7t + 15t = 44 km

⇒ 8t = 16 km

⇒ t = 2 hours

Distance travelled on bicycle = 15 × 2 = 30 km.

∴ The distance travelled by the man on bicycle was 30 km.
